period_note: Unaudited quarterly financial statements (separate/solo, Bank-only, excludes subsidiaries). Balance sheet is the 30-Sep-2017 snapshot (reported). Income-statement items below are the DISCRETE Jul-Sep 2017 quarter, taken directly from the statement's own 4-column layout (Jan-Sep'17, Jan-Sep'16, Jul-Sep'17, Jul-Sep'16). This report's own Jul-Sep'16/Jan-Sep'16 comparative columns match this dataset's 2016_Q3.json exactly. This is the second consecutive weak/loss quarter in 2017 (after Q1's provision-driven dip): discrete Q3 net interest income fell to 256,300,614, and a large provision expense (1,002,647,372) drove both PBT (-528,120,112) and net profit after tax (-218,510,442) negative despite another large deferred-tax benefit — consistent with the weak full-year 2017 already on file (2017_Q4.json: ROA 0.01%, ROE 0.13%, EPS 0.03). AB Bank Subordinated Bond fell from 6,500,000,000 to 6,000,000,000 this quarter (a tranche redeemed).

note: GAP: unlike every other quarter in this dataset, this specific source document does NOT contain a loan-classification (Standard/SMA/Substandard/Doubtful/Bad-Loss balance) breakdown anywhere — confirmed by an exhaustive search of the full extracted text (only a provision-requirement note, 14.1.1, giving Required/Maintained PROVISION amounts by category, which cannot be reliably converted back to loan balances without assuming a specific provisioning rate). classified_loans_* and unclassified_* fields are therefore omitted this quarter rather than estimated, per project convention (never fabricate what isn't genuinely sourced). All other fields are fully reported and validated: Total Assets = Total Liabilities + Equity reconciles exactly; interest income minus interest paid = net interest income exactly; PBT minus tax = net profit exactly; Q1+Q2+Q3 2017 (110,306,447 + 251,257,722 - 218,510,442 = 143,053,727) matches the report's own 9M cumulative column exactly. The bank's own 2018 Q3 report restates this quarter's EPS comparative to -0.29 (vs -0.32 contemporaneous here) — a bonus-share weighted-average-share restatement (paid-up capital rose from 6,738,936,140 at this date to 7,581,303,150 by Mar-2018). Contemporaneous value (-0.32) is kept per project convention.
